'''RC-42''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] that was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Rakghoul pandemic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
